description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between sample token count and shared experts for different model types. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>9</sup> to 2<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 2<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples” and has a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. 

The line representing “Intent” is orange and solid; it begins at approximately 3.2 shared experts at a sample token count of 2<sup>9</sup> and increases to approximately 5.8 shared experts at 2<sup>20</sup>. The “Summary” line is blue and solid, starting at approximately 5.6 shared experts at 2<sup>9</sup> and decreasing to approximately 3.1 shared experts at 2<sup>11</sup> before increasing to approximately 3.6 shared experts at 2<sup>20</sup>. The “Law” line is gray and solid, beginning at approximately 4.0 shared experts at 2<sup>9</sup> and increasing to approximately 5.6 shared experts at 2<sup>20</sup>. The “Translation” line is purple and solid, starting at approximately 5.2 shared experts at 2<sup>9</sup> and decreasing to approximately 3.0 shared experts at 2<sup>11</sup> before increasing to approximately 5.2 shared experts at 2<sup>20</sup>. Finally, the “Math” line is green and solid, beginning at approximately 3.8 shared experts at 2<sup>9</sup> and increasing to approximately 5.4 shared experts at 2<sup>20</sup>.
